bug_semantics: When CRuby Nokogiri vendors libxml2, two libxml2 memory-safety bugs are reachable through Nokogiri's DTD/schema APIs. CVE-2025-24928: xmlSnprintfElements (valid.c) formats DTD validation error text into a fixed stack buffer; the remaining-size check counted the QName prefix and local name separately and did not account for prefix+':' +name together, so a ~3kb QName prefix overflows the stack while reporting a validation error (CWE-787/CWE-121). CVE-2024-56171: xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables and xmlSchemaBubbleIDCNodeTables (xmlschemas.c) keep a stale items pointer after xmlSchemaItemListAdd reallocates the identity-constraint duplicate list, a use-after-free on crafted XSD (xsd:keyref plus recursive types with extra identity constraints) or on untrusted instance documents validated against such schemas. Attackers supply malicious DTD/XSD (or documents that trigger DTDVALID) to DoS or potentially execute code. Nokogiri does not reimplement these C functions; it downloads and compiles the pinned libxml2 tarball.
flaw_origin: The overflow and UAF were written in GNOME libxml2 (xmlSnprintfElements / xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables), not in Nokogiri's own C or Ruby. libxml2 before 2.12.10 and 2.13.0–2.13.5 are in-range, so every libxml2 Nokogiri ever packaged was vulnerable until 2.13.6. Nokogiri never vendors that C in-tree (mini_portile downloads the tarball named in dependencies.yml). The smallest Nokogiri commit that first caused the gem to ship a libxml2 containing those functions is 131df0d6bf14a26f31c35f62de0d6b44f0328526 (2008-10-15), which added a Windows cross-compile that downloaded libxml2-2.7.1.win32; the parent tree has no such packaging. Packaged libxml2 later became the default for all CRuby platforms in b79a4fe71948b4326e1aa92ffe63e6dfde7b6d3b (2013-04-14, Nokogiri v1.6.0). Subsequent version pins through 2.13.5 (819b2a8d0fd387d0a0afc648f6ffa1621c22bcd4) only carried the same upstream defects.

reasoning: CVE-2025-71407 is a published VulnCheck downstream CVE wrapping the vendor GHSA-vvfq-8hwr-qm4m bump of packaged libxml2, not a withdrawn or false report. The sinks are libxml2's xmlSnprintfElements (stack overflow when emitting DTD validation errors for a long QName prefix) and xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables/xmlSchemaBubbleIDCNodeTables (UAF after xmlSchemaItemListAdd realloc). Those C functions are not in sparklemotion/nokogiri; Nokogiri only pins and compiles a libxml2 tarball. Because the libxml2 CVEs cover essentially all historical versions until 2.13.6/2.12.10, the first Nokogiri commit that shipped a libxml2 containing the sinks is the BIC: 131df0d6bf14a26f31c35f62de0d6b44f0328526 added Windows cross-compile download of libxml2-2.7.1.win32, and that string is absent at parent 93761f9965b827fbf6585ee67fe50da75678a74c. Later default-packaging (b79a4fe7) and the 2.13.5 pin are carriers, not first-writes, and are not treated as BICs. Tag check: BIC is an ancestor of v1.18.2 (affected); the 2.13.6 pin merge a8c526ad is v1.18.3~1 (patched boundary).
